info.title: basecamp3 (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Basecamp 3 REST API. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {access_token}. The account ID is part of the base URL path. Projects are called 'buckets'. Each project has a todoset which contains todolists. Todos are created inside todolists.

post.summary: Add a new to-do item within a specific todolist. The accountId, projectId, todoSetId, and todolistId must be known ahead
post.description: Add a new to-do item within a specific todolist. The accountId, projectId, todoSetId, and todolistId must be known ahead of time (they can be found via the Basecamp UI or API). The todoset ID is available from the project's dock.

parameters.name: todoSetId
parameters.description: Identifier for the todoset within the project.

parameters.name: todolistId
parameters.description: Identifier for the todolist within the todoset.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the todo.

content.description: Title or body text of the task.

status.description: Whether the todo is currently active or has been completed.

due_on.description: Deadline for the todo in YYYY-MM-DD format.
